paired-uv/scope-decision.json.reason: Parent review fixed the uv publication scope at two real edit pairs plus one cold pair regardless of direction, to bound the investigation. The one-off screen is separate; Ruff provides four edit and three cold pairs. UV repeated measurements remain limited confirmation, not universal proof.

hypotheses.early_dce_then_merge: Single Ruff screen only; difference from merge alone is inconclusive, so no extra pass included in the patch.
hypotheses.early_merge: Selected narrow experiment; opt-in flag leaves release optimization and fat-LTO settings intact.
hypotheses.parallel_post_lto_codegen: Deferred architectural direction supported by an instrumented profile, not implemented or timed as a candidate.
hypotheses.retain_analyses: Single Ruff screen essentially flat compile time with about 34 percent greater peak child RSS; binary identical to baseline. Not selected.

notes: Paired shipping-compiler plugin measurements preserve PGO/BOLT provenance. Compiled implementation parity is a separate check.

Earlier -Zprint-llvm-passes stderr equality was only legacy machine-pass listing equality, not full optimization-pipeline proof. The corrected test uses -Zautodiff=PrintPasses stdout and asserts the mergefunc pass is present.
Ruff baseline-repeat was a cached artifact restoration without compilation and is excluded.

Ruff runtime-v1 failed an exact stderr hash assertion because the same two warnings reorder even within identical baseline runs. All raw streams from runtime-v2 were retained and the complete warning-line multiset validated.
Instrumented Ruff profile is attribution only: its timing was invalidated by a transient compiler ancestry observation and instrumentation materially increases runtime.
Cold means empty task-owned target artifacts with cached dependency downloads and default concurrency. Entry edits and cold builds are reported separately.
All peak RSS values are the maximum child-process RSS in KiB, not a sum of concurrent process RSS.
